\section*{Right-Triangle Trigonometry}
\textit{Angles of elevation and depression}
\begin{enumerate}
  \item Find the side opposite a $35^\circ$ angle when the hypotenuse is 9.
  \item Find the side adjacent to a $35^\circ$ angle when the hypotenuse is 9.
  \item A right triangle has legs 3 and 4. Find the hypotenuse.
  \item Find the angle whose opposite leg is 5 and adjacent leg is 8.
  \item A right triangle has legs 8 and 15. Find the hypotenuse.
  \item Find the angle whose opposite leg is 4 and hypotenuse is 9.
\end{enumerate}
